name: CaseBorderColorControlEqual
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "border-color-control-equal" (paint). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a border-color EQUAL to the bare control element's (a library global like shadcn's `* { border-color: var(--border) }` styles the control too) on a part that draws a real border
